clue.text: Complaint from empty fellow, as it were

indicators.note: the phrase asks the solver to take an empty fellow literally, a man with nothing (zero) put inside him

parts.note: a fellow is a man
empty means nothing, the zero-shaped letter O

explanation.surface: A grumble coming from a hollow, vacant sort of chap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'empty fellow' looks like a description of a shallow man; 'as it were' signals reading it literally, so the nothing (O) goes inside MAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A grievance voiced as a low grumble is a synonym of the noun complaint.

clue.text: Male scrapped thing hated by drivers as source of income

indicators.note: scrapped means broken up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a parking or speeding ticket is a motorist's bane

explanation.surface: A man disposing of a hated motorist's item for profit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scrapped' rearranges MALE to MEAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone or something relied on to provide a living is a reliable earner, an idiom.

clue.text: A new thing said to garner attention around international entertainment venue

indicators.note: around means the word to get attention surrounds the letter

parts.note: ahem is a cough said to draw attention

explanation.surface: A novelty spoken to catch the eye at a global show.
explanation.definitionFit: This Californian city is home to Disneyland, a theme park and entertainment destination.

clue.text: Deny scarf's misplaced in party costume?

indicators.note: letters that are misplaced are put in the wrong positions, so these ten letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone refuses that their scarf has gone missing, in a sentence about costume.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram uses the S of 'scarf's' too: DENYSCARFS rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Outfits worn to a themed party, dressing up as a character, are this kind of costume; the question mark flags that it is a description by example.

clue.text: Dope enters a company emptied for business

indicators.note: enters means goes inside the outside letters
emptied removes the inner letters, leaving the first and last

parts.note: gen is slang for information, as is dope

explanation.surface: A drug gets into a firm stripped bare for trading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'emptied' keeps only the outer letters of 'company'; 'enters' puts the dope after the A. 'Dope' as information is a crossword staple, like gen.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm providing a service, like a travel bureau, is a business.

clue.text: Perhaps, Scot snubbed man eating a vegetable

indicators.note: snubbed suggests cut short, so the final letter is removed

parts.note: a Scot is an example of a Celt

indicators.note: eating means taking in, so the name surrounds the letter

parts.note: Eric is a man's name

explanation.surface: A Scottish man is ignored while eating a vegetable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'snubbed' trims CELT to CEL; ERIC eating A gives ERIAC.
explanation.definitionFit: A knobbly root related to celery, eaten raw or mashed, is a vegetable.

clue.text: Shadow boxer, maybe

definitions.meaning: to shadow someone is to follow them closely
a boxer is a breed of hound, an example of a canine

explanation.surface: A fighter practising against an imaginary opponent.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to trail persistently; as a noun the boxer is one example of the breed.

clue.text: Like a professor, possibly merited no end of acclaim around university?

indicators.note: around means the rearranged letters surround the university letter
possibly signals another arrangement of the letters
no means without, so the letter is removed
end of means the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: An academic deserved endless praise at the college.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no end of acclaim' takes M (the end of 'acclaim') from MERITED; 'possibly' rearranges ERITED around U.
explanation.definitionFit: Scholarly and learned, the qualities of an academic, is a fitting description.

clue.text: Confined space, we're told, is put on market

indicators.note: we're told means heard spoken, so the word sounds like another

parts.note: a cell is a small enclosed room

explanation.surface: A tiny room that is up for sale, it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: To offer goods for purchase is to trade them, putting them on the market.

clue.text: Enjoyment over day is rare sadly in charitable event

indicators.note: in a down clue over places one piece above, so before, the next

parts.note: fun is enjoyment

indicators.note: sadly signals a sorry, disordered state, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fun on a day that unfortunately doesn't come often at a charity do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sadly' rearranges IS RARE into RAISER.
explanation.definitionFit: A gathering held to collect money for a good cause is a charity event.

clue.text: A Northern rugby team encapsulating its sport usually

indicators.note: encapsulating means enclosing, so the team's name wraps around the sport

parts.note: Sale Sharks are a rugby union club from Sale, near Manchester in northern England
the team's sport is rugby union, abbreviated RU

explanation.surface: A rugby club in the north of England capturing the essence of its game.
explanation.walkthrough: SALE is a town near Manchester whose Sale Sharks play rugby union; RU, the usual abbreviation for rugby union, sits inside it after A.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means generally or normally, a straightforward synonym for usually.

clue.text: Practical joke, say, before quiet in period of rest

indicators.note: in means the two pieces go inside the word for a period of rest

parts.note: a lull is a quiet period of rest

indicators.note: before puts one piece ahead of the other in reading order

parts.note: say introduces an example, abbreviated EG
P stands for piano, the musical term for quiet

explanation.surface: A prank, for example, followed by silence during a break.
explanation.walkthrough: EG and P go into LULL in that order to give L-EG-P-ULL.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoax or teasing deception played on someone is a practical joke, synonym.

clue.text: Incline to accept latest piece of menswear fashion

indicators.note: to accept means to take in, so the verb for incline holds the letter

parts.note: to incline towards something is to tend

indicators.note: the latest piece of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A tendency to take on the newest item of men's clothing as a style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Incline' looks like the definition, but it is the wordplay piece TEND; the definition is 'fashion' at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A current style or vogue is a synonym of fashion.

clue.text: Tidy a car nervously for draped female figure

indicators.note: done nervously means done jerkily and out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone anxiously cleans a car before showing a dressed woman's form.
explanation.definitionFit: In classical architecture a column carved as a robed woman is this sculpted female support.

clue.text: Minutes might be like this in a countdown outside work time

definitions.text: Minutes might be like this in a countdown
definitions.meaning: on a digital countdown display minutes come next in line behind hours
beyond official opening times, as with drinking at a pub

explanation.surface: A countdown clock seen beyond normal office times.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, minutes sit next to the hours; as a phrase it means beyond normal business times.

clue.text: Details put wrongly in a prescriptive form?

indicators.note: put wrongly means set in the wrong order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Particulars incorrectly placed in a set format.
explanation.definitionFit: Laid down as a requirement, specified as a condition, describes something put in prescriptive terms.

clue.text: Doctor dons jacket for action

indicators.note: to don is to put on clothing, so the doctor goes inside the jacket

parts.note: a jacket is a coat
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A medic puts on a jacket ready to get going.
explanation.definitionFit: Fighting or military engagement, as in troops seeing action, is a synonym.

clue.text: Damage sides of range in island close to resort

indicators.note: in means the outside letters are placed within the island's name

parts.note: Malta is a Mediterranean island

indicators.note: the sides of a word are its first and last letters
close to means the end of the word

explanation.surface: Someone harms the edges of a mountain range on an island near a holiday spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'range' tempts as a mountain chain or a cooker, but only its outer letters are used; 'in' places them within the island.
explanation.definitionFit: To treat cruelly or abuse is to do damage, used as a verb.

clue.text: Great pic for broadcast giving evidence of value

indicators.note: broadcast also means scattered widely, so the letters are spread out anew

explanation.surface: An excellent picture being aired shows its worth.
explanation.definitionFit: A label showing what an item costs indicates its worth, evidence of value.

clue.text: Single female in troubled year as agent

indicators.note: in means the unmarried woman goes inside the rearranged letters
troubled means disturbed, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: Miss is the title of an unmarried woman

explanation.surface: An unmarried woman during a difficult year works as an operative.
explanation.walkthrough: 'troubled' scrambles the year's letters, and 'in' sets the single female among them, splitting them after the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An envoy sent on a mission is a representative or agent.

clue.text: People characterising monks?

definitions.meaning: to people a place is to live in or occupy it, a verb
monks are typically dressed in a robe, being in a monastic habit

explanation.surface: Folk who are typical of monastic brothers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'People' looks like a noun but is the verb to populate; the second reading splits into IN HABIT.
explanation.definitionFit: To dwell in or occupy a place is to people it; monks, wearing robes, are clothed in a habit.

clue.text: Eagerly obtain drink put in dessert from the East

indicators.note: put in means the drink is placed inside the dessert
in an across clue, reading from the East means right to left, so the dessert is reversed

parts.note: pud is short for pudding, a dessert
rum is a spirit drink

explanation.surface: A spirit added to a pudding from the Orient.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue 'from the East' means read right to left; only the dessert is turned, and 'put in' sets the drink after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To drum up support or business is to work to obtain it with energy.

clue.text: Hands-on technique in service over period

indicators.note: in a down clue over places the first piece above the next

parts.note: Mass is a church service
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A practical approach used during a church service across an era.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbing and kneading the body by hand is literally a hands-on therapy.

clue.text: Boss with idol regularly in film production site

parts.note: a boss is a stud, a raised knob on a surface

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the word

explanation.surface: A manager with a pop star at a movie lot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boss' looks like a manager but is a raised ornamental knob.
explanation.definitionFit: A building where movies are shot is a film production site.

clue.text: Convenient route to get copper?

parts.note: the chemical symbol for copper is CU, which is the word cut made short by losing its last letter

explanation.surface: A quick way to fetch a policeman.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: cutting CUT short leaves CU, the chemical symbol for copper. 'copper' tempts as a police officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A quicker path than the usual way is a handy, convenient route.

clue.text: Flier offering employment in role essentially

indicators.note: in means the employment word goes inside the central letters
essentially points to the essence, the middle of the word

parts.note: employment of something is its use

explanation.surface: A pilot offering work within the core of a job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flier' suggests a pilot or a leaflet, but it is a bird; 'essentially' keeps the two central letters of 'role', and 'in' splits them.
explanation.definitionFit: A blackbird, an old name for a thrush-like songbird, is a flier in crossword terms.

clue.text: Expatriate crumpled clothing of an off-white colour

indicators.note: clothing means the outer words wrap around and conceal the letters within

explanation.surface: An expatriate wearing wrinkled clothes in a pale shade.
explanation.definitionFit: A pale beige or unbleached linen shade is an off-white colour.

clue.text: Conservative elected amid support in political grouping

indicators.note: amid means in the middle of, so the elected word goes inside support

parts.note: to abet is to support or assist
elected means in, as a party voted into office

explanation.surface: A Tory voted in among backers within a political group.
explanation.definitionFit: The senior ministers forming a government are a political body, a grouping of ministers.

clue.text: Indians supply this aged family member

definitions.meaning: Indian restaurants serve a flat leavened bread

explanation.surface: Indians provide this elderly relative.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Indians' means Indian restaurants, which serve the flatbread, also spelt naan.
explanation.definitionFit: The bread is a staple of Indian menus; the same word is a familiar name for a granny.

clue.text: Sleeping worker found in a side of dustcart?

indicators.note: found in means placed inside the outside letters
a side of the word is either its first or its last letter

parts.note: a side of dustcart could be one or the other, D OR T, so this word supplies the OR between them
a worker is a man, a hand

explanation.surface: A refuse collector found asleep on the side of the bin lorry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a side of dustcart' is either end letter, this one or that, so the wordplay literally spells out one letter, the word for 'or', then the other. A dustcart is the British name for a garbage truck.
explanation.definitionFit: Inactive or asleep, like a dormant volcano, is a synonym for sleeping.

clue.text: Goon, drop-out sadly ignoring right — like a criminal?

indicators.note: sadly signals the letters are in a sorry, disordered state and must be rearranged
ignoring means leaving out a letter

explanation.surface: A fool and a dropout are miserably cast aside as outlaws.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignoring right' removes R from GOONDROPOUT before 'sadly' rearranges the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A person planning mischief or crime is engaged in illicit activity, so the phrase describes a criminal.

clue.text: Fighter scheduled to return for conflict

parts.note: F is the designation for a fighter aircraft, as in F-16

indicators.note: to return means to go back, so the word for scheduled is read backwards

parts.note: due means scheduled, expected at a set time

explanation.surface: A boxer is booked to come back for another bout.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-running quarrel or vendetta is a kind of conflict.
